summary: Structured contact experience — ascent through multi-level building to central command room, conversation with non-human commander 'Saputnik'
description: Vivid experiential encounter inside a tall building with an off-white/beige interior with green-ish tones. Stairs led upward through multiple levels. Beings of various shapes were encountered along the ascent. At the top, bars blocked the entrance to a central command room — entry was permitted. Inside, met the central commander named 'Saputnik', described as not from our planet. Asked him 'Do they cry?' — he responded 'They don't have the technology yet.' Saputnik provided information about 'Anatoly the third', stating the third version will return stronger. Experience had vivid, consistent internal logic distinct from typical dreaming — felt like an actual conversation in a real location.

summary: Green-ish dome structure with grass on top, middle door entrance, large meeting being held inside
description: Vivid vision of a dome-shaped structure with a green-ish exterior and grass growing on top. The structure had a central door entrance. Inside, a large meeting or assembly was being held. The architectural style was organic — the dome blended with the natural environment, grass covering the exterior as if the structure was partially earth-integrated.

summary: Military conflict scene at night near a body of water with sandy shoreline
description: Vision of a military war scenario in a distant, unidentified location. The scene was set at night. Located nearby a body of water — initially thought to be a lake but possibly a sea, as sandy terrain was visible along the shoreline. The setting had a remote, desolate quality.

summary: RV session: fleet of open-ring craft returning through alpine valley toward mountain facility
description: Untargeted remote viewing session. Perceived a steep alpine valley with dense conifer forests and a river cutting through below. Observed from a grassy overlook/meadow edge. A fleet of craft moved in loose V-pattern formation through the valley corridor, following the terrain. The craft appeared lightweight with an open or segmented ring design — not solid discs but skeletal, with more space between the ring segments. The fleet behavior suggested a routine return to a facility embedded in or under the mountain — not a display or flyover but an operational pattern, like a squadron coming back to base. The viewer was not targeting anything specific and 'just ended up there.' Post-session feeling was energized, not drained, suggesting permitted or invited observation rather than forced access.

summary: RV session: flat empty landscape, object initially appeared as airplane then resolved as disc
description: Remote viewing session in which the viewer perceived a flat, featureless landscape with no buildings or human infrastructure — just empty terrain. Looked up and initially perceived an airplane, but the object gradually resolved into a disc shape. The perceptual shift from airplane to disc may represent the analytical mind attempting to normalize the data before the actual signal overrode it (classic RV pattern). The temporal placement felt ambiguous — not near-present, either significantly in the past or in the future. The absence of any human development suggests either extreme remoteness in the present, or a different era entirely.
